picks.name: O-Tsukimi Moon Viewing
picks.description: The Portland Japanese Garden marks the autumn harvest moon with O-Tsukimi — an evening of moonlit strolls, tea, music, and seasonal beauty. A serene, once-a-year way to open the weekend.

picks.name: Chrome Warehouse Sale
picks.description: Portland-made Chrome Industries opens its NW warehouse for deep deals on bags, apparel, and gear — the once-a-season chance to score their tough, cult-loved goods for less.

picks.name: Cathedral Park Porch Concerts
picks.description: Free, family-friendly live music under the Gothic arches of the St. Johns Bridge at Cathedral Park. Bring a blanket, let the kids run, and take in one of the prettiest spots in the city.

picks.name: Sellwood Dog Show
picks.description: Sellwood Community House hosts its beloved neighborhood dog show at the Shack — categories for waggiest tail, best costume, and more. Free, family-friendly, and heavy on very good boys and girls.

picks.name: Thrill the World Practice
picks.description: Portland joins the global "Thrill the World" by learning Michael Jackson's "Thriller" zombie dance en masse at Irving Park. Free, all levels — nail the moves for the big synchronized day. Practices are every Saturday and Sunday 11:30 AM–1 PM through October 18th.

picks.name: The Wedge Cheese Fest
picks.description: Portland's giant cheese celebration returns to Alder Block — taste hundreds of cheeses, meet the makers, and wash it all down with perfect pairings. A dairy-lover's dream afternoon.

picks.name: Cedar Mill Cider Fest
picks.description: Cedar Mill's historic Young House presses the season with a free cider festival — fresh apple cider, live music, and old-fashioned fall fun for the whole family. A cozy way to welcome autumn.

picks.name: Portland Repair Fairs
picks.description: Bring your broken lamp, bike, or busted zipper — volunteer fixers help you mend it for free at Repair PDX's community fairs. Keep stuff out of the landfill and learn a thing or two while you wait. www.repairpdx.org for details on times and locations.
